name: CausticContagion / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. Two distinctly spaced viscous chemical bubble bursts with a crackly papery spore flutter between them, ending in a brief sour wet fizz. Acid and toxic contagion, pulsing organic texture.
